purpose: Freeze the raw source boundary and sign/coverage rules required before any distributed-lag exchange-rate pass-through estimation for Romania.

exchange_rate.concept: Monthly average Romanian leu per euro ECB reference exchange rate
exchange_rate.source_coverage_evidence: ECB Data Portal reports monthly coverage beginning in January 1999.

inflation.dataset: prc_hicp_minr — HICP ECOICOP version 2, monthly indices and rates
inflation.concept: Romania all-items HICP under ECOICOP version 2
inflation.coverage_note: Live structure probe on 2026-09-19 reports time coverage 1996-01 through 2026-08 for the Romania dataset query. Exact TOTAL/I25 observations must be retained in the common source vintage.
inflation.migration_note: The former prc_hicp_midx / ECOICOP v1 dataset is archived and discontinued for current 2026 data; it may not be silently spliced into the current source boundary.

exact_control.live_probe_coverage: 2002-01 through 2026-06; 294 non-null monthly observations in the 2026-09-19 live structure probe
exact_control.role: external-price proxy; not a pure transaction-price import-price index
exact_control.currency_boundary: No currency dimension is exposed by this short-term API extract; do not invent or search a currency variant after model fit.

transformation_boundary.fx_change_candidate: log difference of the monthly-average RON-per-EUR series
transformation_boundary.inflation_raw_input: HICP ECOICOP v2 TOTAL, unit I25 (2025=100), monthly index
transformation_boundary.rationale: Monthly log change, year-on-year inflation and seasonally adjusted transforms answer different questions. The transform and lag horizon must be preregistered only after raw-source completeness and revision properties are frozen, not chosen from fit.

required_before_estimation: Retain the exact ECB EXR.M.RON.EUR.SP00.A monthly-average RON/EUR series with raw bytes, provider metadata and SHA-256.
Retain the exact Eurostat prc_hicp_minr monthly Romania series with unit=I25, coicop18=TOTAL, geo=RO and raw bytes/SHA-256.
Retain the exact Eurostat ext_st_27_2020msbec monthly series with freq=M, stk_flow=IMP, indic_et=IVU, partner=WORLD, bclas_bec=TOTAL, geo=RO and raw bytes/SHA-256.
Retain one normalized level-only common-month CSV without interpolation, backfill, missing-to-zero conversion or inflation/FX transformations.

Only after exact source-vintage retention, freeze inflation transform, external-price transform, FX transform, lag horizon, regime/estimation start, structural-selection window and untouched evaluation window before any coefficient estimation.
prohibited_shortcuts: Use end-of-period exchange rates when the frozen driver is monthly average without a new source-boundary contract.
Switch between CPI and HICP after seeing model performance.
Select monthly versus year-on-year inflation transform from holdout fit.
Choose lag length after opening untouched evaluation data.
Treat correlation between RON depreciation and inflation as causal pass-through.
Import pre-inflation-targeting or pre-current-regime coefficients as current Romanian parameters.
Substitute INT, CAP, CONS or CONS_TRA for TOTAL after seeing model performance.
Infer a RON- or EUR-denominated IVU variant that is not exposed by the exact short-term dataset query.
source_materialisation_gate.pass_effect: Authorises a separately preregistered structural-selection cycle against autoregressive and external-price baselines; no causal or System Dynamics activation follows automatically.
source_materialisation_gate.fail_effect: Retain the mechanism as CANDIDATE and do not estimate an under-controlled distributed-lag equation.
